note: 流程预设：mermaid 引擎节点（重引擎，内容刻意保持极小但合法）+ steps 同一节奏的文字版。展示“自动布局需求才用 mermaid”。

items.content: 围栏 JSON 是数据，不是脚本。箭头只表示因果，不表示渲染顺序。

items.code:
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as 用户
    participant B as 界面
    participant M as 模型
    U->>B: 点按钮 (action)
    B->>M: 回传 action
    M->>B: 新的 dsh-ui 围栏
    B->>U: 就地渲染

steps.title: 本地即时
steps.desc: 排序、过滤、判卷、折叠都不出浏览器

steps.title: 显式 action
steps.desc: 只有需要新内容或执行工具时才回传

steps.title: 新的界面
steps.desc: 模型返回一棵新组件树，同一位置重绘

items.title: 为什么大多数点击不需要动作
items.content: 界面自己能完成的状态变化，交给浏览器做完就好。把往返留给真正需要模型的那一步。
Fence JSON is data, not script. The arrows show cause and effect, not render order.

items.code:
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as Reader
    participant B as Interface
    participant M as Model
    U->>B: Click (action)
    B->>M: Send action back
    M->>B: New dsh-ui fence
    B->>U: Render in place

steps.title: Local first
steps.desc: Sorting, filtering, grading and collapsing never leave the browser

steps.title: Explicit action
steps.desc: Sent only when new content or a tool run is needed

steps.title: A new interface
steps.desc: The model returns a new component tree, redrawn in the same place

items.title: Why most clicks need no action
items.content: State the interface can change on its own belongs to the browser. Save the round trip for the step that truly needs the model.
